description: The same grant as `default`, to the development server alone, and in a development launch only. `tauri.conf.json` names `default` in `app.security.capabilities`, so a release build embeds that one and not this file; `tauri.dev.conf.json` names both. The list has to stay explicit: an empty one means every file in this directory, this one included. It used to be two lines in `default.json`, which put `http://localhost:3010` in every installed app — anything that could listen on that port on somebody's machine would have been treated as their deployment and handed the shell's commands. The permissions repeat `default`'s exactly (tests/desktop-shell.test.ts reads them together), so a development launch exercises what people install.
